verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that ElevenLabs Agents is a HIPAA-eligible service, that BAAs are offered to eligible customers, and that customers can build voice agents that handle PHI. Configurable retention of transcripts and audio adds some regulated-workload control. SOC 2 and data residency are not evidenced; the only security claim is a generic 'enterprise-grade security' marketing line. Missing for 10: SOC 2 attestation evidence, data-residency/region options, independent corroboration of HIPAA/BAA eligibility.
